Title: Broken db import in user/listings API
Description: Imports { db } which doesn't exist in firebase-admin.js. Should be getAdminFirestore().

Title: Broken db import in user/messages/count API
Nav bar overlap - Noticeboard hidden by geolocation button
Description: The 'Show listings near me' geolocation button overlaps the 'Noticeboard' nav link intercepting pointer events. Clicking Noticeboard actually clicks the geo button.

Title: Marketplace category tabs don't filter results
Description: Switching category tabs (Computers & Laptops / Mobile Phones / Tablets / etc.) changes the heading text but items remain identical. Count stays at 6073. Same items displayed regardless of tab selected.

Title: The Hub main page renders blank
Description: Navigating to /the-hub renders an empty <main> tag with no content. No error shown. Page is completely blank.

Title: Post Ad page stuck redirect for unauthenticated users
Description: Shows 'Redirecting to dashboard...' text but never actually redirects to /login for unauthenticated users. Should redirect to login.

Title: Excessive Fast Refresh rebuilds and Long Task warnings
Description: Console shows 30-50+ '[Fast Refresh] rebuilding' messages per page load and repeated 'Long Task detected' warnings. Indicates performance issues in dev mode.

Title: No validation on empty registration form submit
Description: Clicking 'Create Account' with all fields empty shows no validation error messages. Just focuses the email field silently. Should show required field errors.

Title: Verify email 'Skip for now' creates redirect loop
Description: 'Skip for now' link on /verify-email points to /dashboard which redirects unverified users back to /verify-email creating an infinite redirect loop. Unverified users are completely locked out of dashboard.

Title: Raw Firebase error shown on invalid login
Description: Invalid login shows raw 'Firebase: Error (auth/invalid-login-credentials).' instead of user-friendly message like 'Invalid email or password'.

Title: Hub admin page accessible to unauthenticated users
Description: Unauthenticated users can access /the-hub/admin which renders the admin sidebar layout with 'Loading community...' spinner. Should redirect to login. Note: API endpoints properly return 401.

Title: Property type filter (rent/sale) ignored by API
Description: The type query parameter is ignored. Both ?type=rent and ?type=sale return the same total (4930) as unfiltered requests. Frontend shows different counts (36300 rent vs 69930 total) suggesting client-side filtering on a different dataset.

Title: Inconsistent redirect param names across pages
Description: /dashboard redirects to /login?redirect=%2Fdashboard while /profile redirects to /login?returnUrl=/profile. Should use consistent parameter naming.

Title: Garbled Unicode emoji in listing addresses
Description: Some listing addresses display garbled text like 'ð³ð¬' instead of Nigerian flag emoji (🇳🇬). Encoding issue in stored data.

Title: User API endpoints return 400 instead of 401 for unauthenticated
Description: These endpoints return 400 Bad Request instead of 401 Unauthorized when no auth token is provided. All other protected endpoints correctly return 401.

Title: Hub communities API uses inconsistent response format
Description: Returns { communities } shape while all other listing APIs use { success data pagination } format. Inconsistent API contract.
